messages:
Elena: Nightly run flagged 12 card declines. Gateway shows 3 do_not_retry, 7 insufficient_funds, 2 issuer_decline. Thoughts on immediate action?

billing-bot: Summary: invoices [INV-9341, INV-9344, INV-9350, ...]. At-risk MRR: $18,400.

Tom: For soft declines let's do retries at now + 8h + 24h (historical success best at 8h). For do_not_retry, do not auto-retry; trigger card-update email and mark manual-collect.

Maya: Agreed. Also: two invoices >$6k 9should surface wire option in the email and pause retries until finance verifies wire details.

Elena: Approved plan. Please add retry audit logs to invoice history and flag any retry that returns `card_not_on_file` for manual follow-up.

Tom: Dry-run command: ./billing retry --filter "status:declined method:card code:soft" --schedule "0h,8h,24h" --dry-run --log=true
Will execute live after dry-run OK.

Maya: I'll draft the customer note: short subject "Payment attempt failed for your Redwood invoice" with link to update card and a line: "Reply WIRE to request bank details." Posting to #customer-ops for AE quick check.

billing-bot: Actions logged: retry_dry_run(12 soft candidates), manual_collect_flag(3), hold_for_wire(2). Ticket FIN-4620 created.

Elena: Dry-run OK, no rate-limit warnings. Kicking off live sweep now and uploading audit export to FIN/collections/1839007770.csv. Tagging @Tom for any gateway errors.

Tom: Standing by.
